name: Graph Search & Shortest Paths
description: Depth-first search with discovery and finish times, then single-source shortest paths with Dijkstra's algorithm and Bellman-Ford's negative-cycle check.
highlights: Recursive DFS that colours vertices white, gray and black and records timestamps
Dijkstra: repeatedly settle the closest unsettled vertex and relax its edges
Bellman-Ford: relax every edge |V| − 1 times, then one more pass to detect negative cycles
